method: Manual formula/customer-support and source-to-body comparison; not a new program audit.

checks.name: full-model
checks.review: Finite unit customers, same finite nonempty common catalogue, m≥1, all ordered-history pure SPE when used; local arbitrary leaf algebra explicitly not IC; empty/repeated/zero/ties retained.

checks.name: q-nonnegativity
checks.review: Original q/N positive denominators; β common-coverer formula strict positive only nonempty prefix; no false past IC.

checks.name: comp
checks.review: Parent tail classified retained K / lost-all Z / lost-but-covered Q+H. Exact identity uses b+(cW−b)=cW. No separate spending of same parent column.

checks.name: hrow
checks.review: Loss count R≤cB gives designated child subprofit h≤pW; no replacement by whole future.

checks.name: joint-h
checks.review: Combined input totals λ/θ in same box, conservation and column bound L(pB−K−Z); residual L(K+Z), not missing L.

checks.name: marg
checks.review: All role pairs for same shared client yield ROW/COL and total shared clients. New W clients excluded; common prefix whole-row special.

checks.name: support
checks.review: M can mix past role labels; H tail can route k>l. Neither automatically inherits original nondecreasing prices or R-only source-HIT.

checks.name: boundaries
checks.review: Two complete SPE policies and forced leaves fully stated; old claim or two children exceed total parent welfare. Forced child is not required SPE.

checks.name: review-phases
checks.review: 4730 statement before author-proof then credible comparison; 7662 owner statement before author-proof without importing other final phase; related5755 §§1–5 then §6 actual author-proof read.

checks.name: transport-state
checks.review: Top strong FOMA refutation dominates stale lower OPEN; canonical 52/1953 strong failures, finite 13-list no contradiction, weak candidate/dynamic budget separate.

checks.name: evidence
checks.review: All4raw/full21claim/4normalshow byte preserved, related same SHA, no program/checker replay; no math PASS or novelty claim.

checks.name: ownership
checks.review: Only C independent stage edits; Root shared copy/Git/checkpoint/done; no extra source claimed or source progress changed.

unproved: Old parent claims / multiple children total capacity
Global actual wallet cap1/cap2 or adaptive resampling/cycle payment
